related.title: RoPE：旋轉位置與相對角度
related.titleEn: RoPE: rotary positions and relative angles
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付視窗分區、位移遮罩與兩層可達圖。；兩成本正確且跨邊界遮罩測試通過；位移前後token數守恆。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver window partitions, shift masks and two-layer reachability.; Both costs match, boundary-mask tests pass and token count is conserved across shifts.
related.difference: 將維度成對，畫旋轉矩陣[[cos,−sin],[sin,cos]]；角度單位明定弧度。；內積.8660254與.5符合，範數1且共同角移不改內積。
related.differenceEn: Pair dimensions and draw the rotation matrix; state radians explicitly.; Dot products match, norms remain1 and common angle shifts preserve the dot product.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 一頭視窗分數元素=(HW/M²)×M⁴=HWM²，假設H,W均可被M整除。；教學特徵56×56，視窗M7；比較M14。；E=56²×49=153664；M14時614656。
二維單位向量分別旋轉θq、θk，其內積cos(θq−θk)；旋轉保持範數。；教學θq=π/3、θk=π/6；再令θk=0。；s=cos(π/6)=.8660254；改後cos(π/3)=.5。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Per-head window attention entries equal HWM², assuming divisibility by window width M.; Teaching56×56 feature map, M7 versus M14.; E=56²×49=153664; M14 gives614656.
Unit vectors rotated by θq and θk have dot product cos(θq−θk); rotations preserve norms.; Teaching θq=π/3,θk=π/6, then θk=0.; s=cos(π/6)=.8660254; changed score cos(π/3)=.5.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GraphSAGE：鄰居取樣與計算樹
related.titleEn: GraphSAGE: neighbor sampling and computation trees
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付視窗分區、位移遮罩與兩層可達圖。；兩成本正確且跨邊界遮罩測試通過；位移前後token數守恆。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver window partitions, shift masks and two-layer reachability.; Both costs match, boundary-mask tests pass and token count is conserved across shifts.
related.difference: 畫seed、四個一跳及每支三個二跳節點，給重複鄰居同一ID。；17與25正確，唯一節點與實例分開，驗證label不進特徵。
related.differenceEn: Draw one seed,four first-hop neighbors and three second-hop children each; use identical IDs for duplicates.; Counts match, unique nodes and instances are separated and validation labels never enter features.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 一頭視窗分數元素=(HW/M²)×M⁴=HWM²，假設H,W均可被M整除。；教學特徵56×56，視窗M7；比較M14。；E=56²×49=153664；M14時614656。
無重複的兩跳展開最多1+s1+s1s2個節點實例；共享鄰居會減少唯一節點數。；教學一個seed，s1=4,s2=3；改s2=5。；N=1+4+4×3=17；改後1+4+4×5=25。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Per-head window attention entries equal HWM², assuming divisibility by window width M.; Teaching56×56 feature map, M7 versus M14.; E=56²×49=153664; M14 gives614656.
A disjoint two-hop expansion contains1+s1+s1s2 node instances; shared neighbors reduce unique nodes.; Teaching one seed,s1=4,s2=3, then s2=5.; N=1+4+4×3=17; changed N=25.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
